title: Cecropins from Plutella xylostella and Their Interaction with Metarhizium anisopliae.

nonblocking_material_gaps: supplementary images were not converted into structured tables because local supplements are figures and captions, not gate-changing table/spreadsheet sources

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material remains complete-with-gaps at packet level, but the remaining gaps are nonblocking for publication-grade review because the local supplements are figure/image assets and no absent table/spreadsheet controls the MIC/database/mechanism result.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Existing structural packet/final artifacts are present; this review does not treat validator success as sufficient by itself.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 rechecked APD6/DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP linked rows against Table 2 values, Fig 1/S1 sequence evidence, and article metadata; target-name differences are recorded as cautions rather than unresolved blockers.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 2 MIC records are retained as raw μM values with peptide entity, target label, source row, and assay context; no toxicity/hemolysis endpoint is fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Final mechanism claims are limited to SEM/TEM morphology and Toll-pathway host-response evidence with direct assay types where applicable.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: The prior worker-6 ticket is closed because source-reviewed worker-4/6 artifacts now preserve all supported local evidence and no blocking/major rework target remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Packet material layer remains material_extracted_with_gaps because supplementary assets are figure images/landing captures, not structured tables; bounded check found no missing local spreadsheet/table needed to change activity/database/mechanism gates.
Database target names are preserved with row-level cautions where they differ from Table 2 spelling or taxonomy labels but match the same MIC values/units.
The current paper reports Px-cec1 activity and aligns cecropin1 in S1 Fig, while exact prior Px-cec1 characterization is cited from the earlier source/database row.
Mechanism claims are limited to source-supported SEM/TEM qualitative morphology and host-response context; no unreported pore/channel quantification is asserted.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 source-reviewed rework closed the framework-test blocker for this paper. Table 2 MIC rows, linked database rows, local sequence/figure evidence, and qualitative mechanism evidence were reopened from packet/local source paths; remaining issues are nonblocking cautions rather than open rework.
